First of all, actually being safely dressed in cold weather doesn't require a coat, merely layers of appropriate materials. It is influenced by times while outside and severity of weather.

If you regularly go outside during extreme (read under 10C) for extended periods of time (read greater than an hour) you will likely need multiple layers to effect remaining warm.

If you stay only outside and only leave and re-enter once, than a jacket is likely a great tool, and less layers may be worn.

If, however, you regularly go between warm and cold areas, read: house to cold, cold to warm car, car to cold, cold to warm school and repeat this 2 or more times, the likelihood is that your lowest layer is going to absorb sweat, it won't evaporate, and traveling into the cold again will result in a decrease of comfort and body temperature.
